Class NetworkConnectionFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.NetworkConnectionFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConnectionFactory
public class NetworkConnectionFactory extends Object implements ConnectionFactory
Concrete ConnectionFactory that establishes the client's connection to the server over either RMI or sockets, returning in both cases a ServerAdapter the client can talk through. It hides the transport-specific setup (RMI registry lookup and stub registration, or opening a socket) behind a uniform creation API.
